consumer.use: Decide whether an effect-lineage prospective-admission rule is semantically stable enough to justify a separately reviewed natural admission-only shadow proposal.

decision_target.question: Can eight fixed adversarial cases be classified with zero material disagreement when prior productive work is tested for effect-lineage membership rather than separated only by the latest intervention label?

intervention.name: effect-lineage prospective admission boundary
intervention.description: Treat earlier productive work as part of the candidate intervention lineage when it already produced the desired change or material sub-effect, exercised the same operative transition/mechanism, or is merely being residualised into automation, durability, hardening, generalisation, repetition or packaging. Require evidence-supported distinctness; otherwise fail closed as indeterminate.

control_condition.description: Use the rejected S0 intervention-relative rule whose anti-renaming guard still allowed residual/durability relabelling and classified candidate-05002 as eligible.

treatment_condition.description: Apply the effect-overlap, transition-overlap and residualisation tests with an evidence hierarchy that does not permit later favourable author prose alone to establish distinctness.

measurement.method: Freeze author classifications for exactly eight adversarial paper cases, then obtain an independent exact-head semantic review. Count any changed classification, required indeterminate downgrade, credible lineage-renaming escape, or finding that distinct-transition controls are rejected merely because prior productive work exists.
measurement.success: Zero material disagreements, zero credible lineage-renaming escapes and zero authority effects. Success establishes paper-level semantic stability only and does not start a natural cohort.
measurement.falsification: One or more material disagreements, a viable lineage/residualisation escape, collapse to blanket prior-mutation exclusion, need for a new validator/control surface, or any productive authority effect rejects this rule revision for pilot use.

cost_metric.method: Measure the independent semantic review handling time only. Any need for new production/control-plane fields remains a separate falsification condition, not a cost tradeoff.

comparison.unit: same fixed case shape evaluated against rejected S0 and S0-R2 where applicable
comparability_constraints: same frozen evidence package used by author and independent reviewer
no productive mutation performed to generate a case
author classifications frozen before independent review
P1 and S0 verdicts referenced and never rewritten
synthetic controls never count as natural-case evidence
confounders: reviewer knowledge of the S0 rejection
synthetic controls are cleaner than natural historical cases

allowed: merged rejected S0 protocol and independent review
primary or contemporaneous GitHub/Bureau/StateStore evidence already referenced by those records

reviewed_exception.rationale: The continuation authorizes only this bounded paper successor. It does not authorize S1, a natural cohort, validator, production integration or a new authority surface.
